signalK.name: signalk-routeiq
signalK.description: Offline nautical route planner with tide and vessel-aware A* pathfinding

routingDataDir.title: Routing Data Directory
routingDataDir.description: Directory containing .sqlite routing graph files. Leave empty to keep them in the plugin's own data directory, which survives plugin updates.

safetyMarginDraft.title: Draft Safety Margin (m)
safetyMarginDraft.description: Under-keel clearance added to design draft

safetyMarginAirDraft.title: Air Draft Safety Margin (m)
safetyMarginAirDraft.description: Mast clearance added to design air draft

safetyMarginBeam.title: Beam Safety Margin (m)
safetyMarginBeam.description: Width clearance added to design beam

defaultCoastDistance.title: Default Min Coast Distance (NM)
defaultCoastDistance.description: Default minimum distance from coastline in nautical miles

averageSpeedKnots.title: Average Speed (kn)
averageSpeedKnots.description: Cruising speed used to estimate route duration / ETA

lockWaitMinutes.title: Typical Lock Wait (min)
lockWaitMinutes.description: Time allowed for each lock on a route. Counts towards the estimated duration and arrival time only — it never changes which way a route goes. A routing database may later carry its own figure for a specific lock, which takes precedence.

bridgeWaitMinutes.title: Typical Opening Bridge Wait (min)
bridgeWaitMinutes.description: Time allowed for each opening bridge on a route. Fixed spans have no wait — you either fit under them or you do not. Counts towards the estimated duration and arrival time only. A routing database may later carry its own figure for a specific bridge, which takes precedence.

considerTides.title: Consider Tides by Default
considerTides.description: Factor tidal currents into route calculation. Needs a tide data plugin: signalk-tidal-currents (real current stations, preferred) and/or signalk-tides (height-derived estimate). With neither installed, routes fall back to plain distance. Clients can override per request.

maxTidalCurrentKnots.title: Max Tidal Current (kn)
maxTidalCurrentKnots.description: Spring-tide current at full flood/ebb used to scale the estimated tidal flow

tidesApiBase.title: Tides API Base URL
tidesApiBase.description: Server hosting the tide/current data plugins (default: this server)

waypointTolerance.title: Waypoint Simplification Tolerance (m)
waypointTolerance.description: Max deviation from the computed path when reducing it to route waypoints (0 = keep every graph node)

wrongWayPenalty.title: Wrong Way Penalty
wrongWayPenalty.description: Penalty multiplier for traveling against traffic flow

lineOfSightSampleInterval.title: Line-of-Sight Sample Interval (m)
lineOfSightSampleInterval.description: Spacing between samples when checking line-of-sight for smoothing

lineOfSightSearchRadius.title: Line-of-Sight Search Radius (m)
lineOfSightSearchRadius.description: Radius to search for graph nodes when verifying line-of-sight

catalogUrl.title: Database Catalog URL
catalogUrl.description: URL to the routing-index.json catalog for downloading routing databases

dynamicLoading.title: Dynamic Database Loading
dynamicLoading.description: Peek installed databases at startup instead of loading all of them; load each region into memory only when a route actually needs it. Leave off for a single-region deployment — there is nothing to gain and startup behavior is unchanged.

eagerLoadAtPosition.title: Eager-load region at vessel position
eagerLoadAtPosition.description: With dynamic loading on, load the region under the vessel at startup and as it moves (via navigation.position), so a positioned vessel boots ready-to-route instead of empty. No effect when dynamic loading is off.

loadRadiusNm.title: Proactive load radius (nm)
loadRadiusNm.description: Load a region when the vessel is within this many nautical miles of it, before it actually crosses in. 0 = only load the region the vessel is inside.

maxLoadedRegions.title: Max loaded regions (dynamic loading)
maxLoadedRegions.description: Only applies with dynamic loading on. Keep at most this many regions loaded in memory, evicting the least-recently-used region once a route finishes and none is in progress. 0 = unlimited (keep every region ever loaded) — uncapped memory growth on long passages.
